Exact declaring-key/member identity and reviewed controls support only the source families marked in stat map.
unresolved: All new values are pre-Season 5 baseline; meaning unconfirmed.

rawChecks[].value is the canonical full-precision serialized numeric value. decodedValue is generic decoder display data, including Float32 rounding to six decimals. Existing compressed evidence is preserved.
The forward source frontier is an import-candidate inventory. Exact pointer selections are only those separately proved by reviewed batches.
Typed scalar/curve/boost/aiming source layouts do not establish speed units, wing physics, boost schedules, turret traverse, lock behavior, repair/resupply rates, or native composition.
Repeated hashes across different declaring keys are never used to mark mapping or name transfer.
L3036 layoutAmbiguous markers and raw-value interpretation limits remain in force; its numeric payloads are referenced without replay.
3 unnamed forward imports remain a current catalog identity boundary; zero named eligible raw gaps is not proof of global absence.
siteImpact: No site changes. No usable native vehicle statistic is established by hash-only source candidates.
